fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
"Build mlibc (riscv64, mlibc-static, gcc)" runs 23 min in one job: shard it
18% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes

Cancel superseded PR runs: no concurrency with cancel-in-progress
Move broad checks to a scheduled sweep
